stem: A triangle has angles of 60° and 80°. What is the measure of the third angle?
visual_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 250 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='250' height='200' fill='#f9f9f9' rx='8'/><polygon points='30,170 220,170 140,30' fill='none' stroke='#3498db' stroke-width='2'/><text x='40' y='162' font-size='13' fill='#333'>60°</text><text x='190' y='162' font-size='13' fill='#333'>80°</text><text x='132' y='55' font-size='13' fill='#e74c3c'>?</text></svg>
solution:
Step 1: The sum of angles in any triangle is 180°.
Step 2: Third angle = 180° − 60° − 80° = 40°.
Answer: 40°.

solution:
Step 1: Area of the outer square (whole garden) = 10 × 10 = 100 m².
Step 2: The inner square has side = 10 − 2(1) = 8 m.
Step 3: Area of the inner square = 8 × 8 = 64 m².
Step 4: Area of the path = 100 − 64 = 36 m².
Answer: 36 m².

Step 3: The perimeter doesn't change! It remains 30 cm.
Answer: 30 cm.

stem: A rectangle and a square have the same perimeter of 20 cm. The rectangle has length 7 cm. Which shape has the greater area, and by how much?
solution:
Step 1: Rectangle: Perimeter = 2(7 + w) = 20, so w = 3 cm. Area = 7 × 3 = 21 cm².
Step 2: Square: Perimeter = 4s = 20, so s = 5 cm. Area = 5 × 5 = 25 cm².
Step 3: Difference = 25 − 21 = 4 cm². The square has the greater area by 4 cm².
Answer: B) Square, by 4 cm².

visual_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 240 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='240' height='180' fill='#f9f9f9' rx='8'/><line x1='20' y1='150' x2='220' y2='150' stroke='#ccc' stroke-width='1'/><line x1='20' y1='150' x2='20' y2='10' stroke='#ccc' stroke-width='1'/><polygon points='20,150 200,150 110,30' fill='#d5e8f0' fill-opacity='0.5' stroke='#3498db' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='20' cy='150' r='3' fill='#e74c3c'/><circle cx='200' cy='150' r='3' fill='#e74c3c'/><circle cx='110' cy='30' r='3' fill='#e74c3c'/><text x='8' y='168' font-size='11' fill='#333'>(0,0)</text><text x='188' y='168' font-size='11' fill='#333'>(6,0)</text><text x='112' y='25' font-size='11' fill='#333'>(3,4)</text></svg>
solution:
Step 1: The base lies along the x-axis from (0,0) to (6,0). Base = 6.
Step 2: The height is the y-coordinate of the top vertex = 4.
Step 3: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 6 × 4 = 12 square units.
Answer: 12 square units.

stem: Which of these points is farthest from the origin (0, 0): (3, 0), (0, 4), or (2, 2)?
solution:
Step 1: Distance of (3, 0) from origin = √(3² + 0²) = √9 = 3.
Step 2: Distance of (0, 4) from origin = √(0² + 4²) = √16 = 4.
Step 3: Distance of (2, 2) from origin = √(2² + 2²) = √8 ≈ 2.83.
Step 4: The farthest point is (0, 4) at distance 4.
Answer: B) (0, 4).
